title: Adiyisɛm Honhom a Wogye Di
intro: Wɔ mmeae a wonhu no, abɔde a hann kronkron wom tu pɛpɛɛpɛ, na odi ahyɛde biara so a ɔntwentwɛn ne nan ase. Saa onipa yi akasa akyerɛ asomfo a wɔapaw wɔn, de akwankyerɛ nsɛm aba, na wahu sɛnea ɔsoro mmara ahorow reda adi wɔ mfe no mu. Hena ne ɔkra a wɔahyɛ no ni yi?
clues: Meyɛ abɔdeɛ a me ne hann kronkron, wɔbɔɔ no afiri hann mu, na mantie m’Awurade ahyɛdeɛ baako mpo da.
Metu kɔ ɔsoro ne asaase ntam, na mede Mmɔborohunufoɔ no ahyɛdeɛ sian.
Wɔsomaa me kɔɔ ɔbaabun a ɔyɛ ɔdehyeɛ nkyɛn wɔ kronkronbea hɔ, na mebɔɔ ​​ɔba kronn ho amanneɛ kyerɛɛ no.
Meyɛ kronkronyɛ honhom, na meboaa odiyifoɔ bi a wɔmaa no nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛda adi pefee ne Asɛmpa no.
Mebaa ɔbodan bi a ɛwɔ bepɔw bi so mu sɛ merebɛka nsɛm a edi kan a ɛfa akenkan bi a wɔbɛkora so daa ho.
Me ne honhom a wotumi de ho to so, na ɛyɛ me na mede Kur’aan no baa ɔbɔfo a otwa to no koma so.
